Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

A new-wave tool in the kits of techies and ripperdocs all over. Affordable and packs a lot of utility for its size.

The Exoglove is a fingerless Smart Glove that counts as a Modular Finger Cyberhand for the installation of up to 5 Cyberfingers. These Cyberfingers fit over top of the user’s existing fingers and do not add extra digits to the user’s hand. An Exoglove cannot install Cyberarm or Cyberlimb Options. When worn, options installed in the glove’s Cyberfingers can be accessed. Putting on or taking off an Exoglove is an Action. The cost to purchase and install a Cyberarm option into the Exoglove is the same cost as doing so in a Cyberarm.

Any options stored in a Cyberhand or meat hand the Exoglove is being worn over are inaccessible while the Exoglove is being worn. Arm-based Cyberware (e.g., Cyberdecks, Popup Weapons/Shields, etc) can be used normally while the Exoglove is worn. The Exoglove cannot be concealed, but it is used so widely by civilians that it is not immediately suspicious to onlookers.

Type: Cyberarm (Foundational)
Install: Mall
Humanity Loss: None
Option Slots: uses 1, provides 5

Foundry notes:

  • Worn, not surgically installed: no Humanity Loss. Install it like cyberware so the sheet tracks the Cyberfingers in it, as the core system does for Smart Glasses and the Battleglove.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware Alternatives > Battle/Smart Gloves).
